replies.help:
Lingo Mate chat assistant supports:
/save <word> — save vocabulary (e.g. /save apple)
Plain messages — learning Q&A
/help — show this help
/new — start a fresh context (rejected while tasks are running; /cancel first)
/cancel — cancel running and queued tasks and invalidate pending confirmations
replies.notBound: This Telegram account is not bound to Lingo Mate yet. Generate a binding code in desktop Settings → Chat Platforms, then send /start <code> to this bot.
replies.alreadyBound: This account is already bound to Lingo Mate.
replies.bindingRequested: Binding requested. Please review the account in desktop Settings → Chat Platforms and confirm.
replies.bindingCodeMismatch: The binding code is incorrect. Please check and retry.
replies.bindingCodeExpired: The binding code has expired. Please generate a new one on the desktop.
replies.bindingCodeExhausted: Too many failed attempts; the binding code was invalidated. Please generate a new one on the desktop.
replies.noActiveBindingCode: No binding code is currently active. Generate one on the desktop first.
replies.confirmationPrompt: Save intent recognized: {{words}} (target language: {{targetLanguage}}). Reply /confirm {{operationId}} to save, or /cancel to abort.
replies.confirmNoPending: There is no pending save confirmation.
replies.confirmLanguageChanged: The target language changed (now {{targetLanguage}}). Please re-confirm: {{words}}. Reply /confirm {{operationId}} to save, or /cancel to abort.
replies.confirmExpired: The confirmation expired. Please send the save request again.
replies.intentClarify: Do you want to save some words? List them directly, e.g. "remember apple". If you are just asking a question, describe it normally.
replies.cancelReport: Cancelled {{cancelled}} task(s) and invalidated pending confirmations. Already committed saves are not rolled back.
replies.cancelIdle: Nothing is running, queued or awaiting confirmation.
replies.newSessionBusy: Tasks are still running, queued or awaiting confirmation. Send /cancel before starting a new context.
replies.queueBusy: This session has too many queued tasks. Please try again later.
replies.rateLimited: Messages are arriving too fast. Please slow down.
replies.messageTooLong: Message is too long (limit 4000 characters). Please split it.
replies.executionFailed: The request could not be completed. Please retry later.
replies.needsAttention: The result of the previous operation is unknown. Please verify in the desktop vocabulary; resend if it was not saved.
replies.offlineNotice: Messages sent while the app is not running are not processed automatically. Please resend them.
